Good to know.

Still have a question?
Ask Blooms by Marra

How do I place an order?

Add sample arrangements to your bag and prepare your request. Copy the summary and send it to Blooms by Marra on Messenger. Your order is confirmed only when the florist accepts it.

Are these the actual products and prices?

This is a sample storefront. Bouquet names, sizes, prices, and photography are illustrative. Ask the florist for current arrangements, flower availability, and a final quote.

Can I request delivery or store pickup?

You can include your preference and date in the request. The florist will confirm delivery coverage, fees, pickup arrangements, and scheduling. No delivery fee is included in the sample subtotal.

Can I customize my bouquet?

Yes, you can request a preferred color, flower, or gift message. Customization and substitutions are subject to the florist’s confirmation and seasonal availability.

Do I pay on this website?

No. This site prepares a request only. Arrange payment directly with the florist after confirming availability, the full total, and applicable cancellation or refund terms.
